_about.what: Trial -> patient condition codes prefilter. A (patient, trial) pair goes to Jev only if the patient passes age/sex and has one of matched_patient_codes (or the trial is flagged healthy_volunteers_no_condition_filter). Measurement rules are suggestions, not applied here.
_about.snomed_targets: SNOMED concepts the trial maps to; a patient code matches if it is the concept or a descendant (is-a closure from tx.fhir.org).
_about.sources: mesh:<id>:<mondo|doid|wikidata> = primary MeSH term mapped by that crosswalk; mesh-child:<child><<parent> = via a MeSH descendant; override:* = overrides.json; word:<text> = condition words found in the SNOMED name.
_about.judgement: correct / too_broad / wrong from gold.json (hand review).
